title: The Last Choir Again
author: Casper Brightwater
blurb: Silas Nystrom, a cartographer of unmapped realms, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
